description: Analyze Solidity source code for potential security vulnerabilities and return candidate findings.
expectedResponse: An object with status, filename, source_sha256, summary, and findings. Each finding must contain id, severity, title, file, line, and evidence. Severity is low, medium, high, or critical. Line is a positive integer.

params.source_code: pragma solidity ^0.8.20; contract VulnerableVault { mapping(address => uint256) public balances; function withdraw() external { uint256 amount = balances[msg.sender]; require(amount > 0); (bool ok,) = msg.sender.call{value: amount}(""); require(ok); balances[msg.sender] = 0; } }
